hero_line: Jun reads Guardian music dispatches to keep every membership and brand pitch rooted in culture.

entries.title: ‘I lost a $3m brand deal. I was like: OK, losers!’ Swedish pop provocateur Zara Larsson on fame, fun and fighting the power
entries.summary: After a decade in pop’s underground, Larsson’s radiant fifth album turned her into one of the world’s biggest stars. It’s about time, she says, relishing the attention without sacrificing her morals

entries.title: Earl Sweatshirt, Mike and Surf Gang: Pompeii // Utility review – rap radicals’ appealing study in contrasts
entries.summary: Earl’s post-Odd Future career swerved the mainstream to follow the path laid out by NYC underground rapper Mike, and their first double album lets both shine

entries.title: Sanaya Ardeshir: Hand of Thought review | Ammar Kalia's global album of the month
entries.summary: The Indian producer steps away from electronics into intricate, slow-building compositions that favour texture and restraint
